answer: The whisper graph is rebuilt each epoch, which means the operator cannot split the cluster faster than the ripple audit merges it again. When a sybil cluster is detected, the slash is applied to the whole cluster and scaled by 8 times its size, so a group of 64 keys loses far more than 64 single identities would. Because the scale factor grows faster than the reward, a large farm is strictly worse off than honest participation, and the crystal checkpoint fixes the penalty permanently.
